name: select_stats_member
purpose: Member selection for Z-stats/Ready. Outside combat (g_location < 0x81) or when the active combatant is not a party member: prints "Player: " (0x96b4), sel = select_party_member(allow_zero); a valid choice echoes the record name (0x55a8 + sel*0x20) and a newline if the cursor is not at column 0. In combat with a party-member active combatant the member is taken from the roster without asking. 0xffff prints "None!\n" (0x96be); 0xfffe ('0') prints a newline. Returns the selection.
notes: Ghidra labels it FONT_e1e0 (FONT vector 1778:0566 targets the same address in FONT.OVL); only ZSTATS ec1a/f476 call this copy

name: show_stats_page
purpose:
Member statistics page: draw_status_icon_bar, draw_status_title(name), window 1 = (9,0x26,1,0x18) cleared with 0xff, then window (9,0x27,1,0x18): g_unk_1a58[class index] leading spaces, the gender glyph (record +9), " Lv-" (0x96d6), level (+0x16) 1 wide, space, class name pointer 0x1a44[class index] (class index = str_index_of(class letter, "AMBFDTPRS" 0x96c6)); line 1: 0xfc + status name 0x1a6a[str_index_of(status, "GPDSC" 0x96d0)]; line 3: 0xfb "Str=" (0x96dc) +0xc (2 wide, '0' pad), "  HP:" (0x96e2) +0x10 (4 wide), "
Int=" (0x96e8) +0xe, "  HM:" (0x96ee) max HP +0x12, "
Dex=" (0x96f4) +0xd, "  Ex:" (0x96fa) +0x14, "

    Magic:" (0x9700) +0xf.

0x1a58.name: g_class_name_indent
0x1a58.meaning: leading spaces before the gender glyph on the stats page

name: print_equipped_slot
purpose: For item != 0xff prints a space, g_short_name_ptrs[item] (0x1962) and a newline. Returns item != 0xff.

name: show_arms_page
purpose: Member Arms page: icon bar, name title, window 1 cleared, 0xfc 0xfe "Arms\n\n" (0x970e) 0xfb 0xfe, then print_equipped_slot for +0x19 helmet, +0x1a armour, +0x1b left hand, +0x1c right hand, +0x1d ring, +0x1e amulet; if none: row 4 0xfc "(None ready)" (0x9716) 0xfb. Window restored to (9,0x27,1,0x18).

name: show_party_equipment_page
purpose:
Party Equipment page: icon bar, title "Equipment" (0x9724), window cleared, "
 Food: " (0x972e) g_food (4 wide), "
 Gold: " (0x9738) g_gold, "

 Keys......." (0x9742) g_keys (2), "
 Gems......." (0x9752) g_gems, "
 Torches...." (0x9760) g_torches, "
 Grapple" (0x976e) when g_grapple != 0.

name: draw_list_frame
purpose: Sets window 1 to (rows+1,0x26,1,0x18), clears it (0xff), sets window (9,0x27,1,0x18) and draws a box: 0x10, 13 x 0x11, 0x13; rows 1..rows-1 get 0x17 at columns 0 and 14; newline; 0x14, 13 x 0x15, 0x16.

name: is_equipped
purpose: Returns 1 when item equals any of the member's six equipment slots (record +0x19..+0x1e), else 0 (Ghidra param_1=item, param_2=member).

name: prev_owned
proto: int prev_owned(int start, int n, u8 *counts, int member)
purpose: Scans downwards from start-1 for the first index whose counts[i] != 0 or (member != 0xff) which the member has equipped; -1 when none (Ghidra param_1=member, param_2=counts, param_3=n unused, param_4=start).

name: next_owned
proto: int next_owned(int start, int n, u8 *counts, int member)
purpose: Scans upwards from start+1 while < n for the first index whose counts[i] != 0 or (member != 0xff) which the member has equipped; -1 when none (Ghidra param_1=member, param_2=counts, param_3=n, param_4=start).

name: print_item_line
proto: void print_item_line(int idx, u8 *counts, char **names, int marker)
purpose: One list line (Ghidra param_1=marker, param_2=names, param_3=counts, param_4=idx). counts[idx] != -1: "--" (0x9778) for 0 else the count 2 wide, then marker (font 1 when < 0x20), font 0. Name names[idx]: '*' -> font 1 "\x1c + " (0x977c) + rest; '!' -> font 1 "\x1d + " (0x9782), font 0, then the name at 0x19b2[idx] (potion colour names for idx 8..15); '(' -> "Moonstone " (0x9788) + next char in font 1; else the name. Pads with spaces to column 14, newline.

0x19b2.name: g_item_alt_name_ptrs
0x19b2.meaning: 0x1916 table + 0x9c: alternate names for '!' entries (potion colours at 0x19c2)

name: inventory_page
proto: int inventory_page(char *title, int n, u8 *counts, char **names)
purpose: Scrolling inventory list page (Ghidra param_1=names, param_2=counts, param_3=n, param_4=title). draw_status_title, draw_list_frame(8); first = next_owned(0xff,..,-1); none: frame again, row 4 col 1 "(None owned!)" (0x9794), icon bar, one read_command_key. Else loop: window 1, (1,1), print_item_line('-',..) for successive owned entries until row 8 (cur = last shown or -1); status icon 0x19 (more below) / 0x18 (more above) / 0x12 (both) / plain bar; window 2, key = read_command_key: space, Esc, 1, 2, '0'..'6' end the page (returned); 3 / 0xd5 scroll up 1 / 7; 4 / 0xd6 scroll down 1 / 7 (only while cur != -1 and more entries exist); 0xd3 first entry; 0xd4 last entry then up to 6 back. Returns the terminating key.
notes: SBORROW2 tests decode as key <= 2 and key <= 0x36

name: snapshot_items_page
purpose: Builds the 0x26-byte Items page at 0xb9ee: [0..8) g_scrolls, [8..16) g_potions, 0xb9fe g_magic_carpets, 0xb9ff g_skull_keys, 0xba00 g_amulet_lb, 0xba01 g_crown_lb, 0xba02 g_sceptre, 0xba03..0xba0a 0xff per moonstone with g_moonstone_loc == 0xff (carried) else 0, 0xba0b..0xba0d the three shards (word + byte copy from 0x57b6), 0xba0e g_spyglasses, 0xba0f 0xff if g_hms_cape_plans else 0, 0xba10 g_sextants, 0xba11 g_pocket_watch, 0xba12 g_black_badge, 0xba13 g_sandalwood_box.

name: zstats_command
purpose: The Z-stats command. sel = select_stats_member(1): 0xfffe -> 6 (page 12 Equipment), negative -> return. "\nStatus: " (0x97a2), snapshot_items_page, clear_status_separator, page = sel*2, key = 0. Loop: key space/Esc -> finish_stats_screen, return. keys 1/3: previous page (12 -> party_count*2-1; 0 -> 16; else -1). 2/4: next page (party_count*2-1 -> 12; 16 -> 0 (ecea); else +1). '0' -> page 12; '1'..'6' with digit-1 < g_party_count -> that member's stats page (digit*2-0x62). select_text_window(1); page < 12: even -> show_stats_page(page/2), odd -> show_arms_page(page/2); 12 -> show_party_equipment_page; 13 Reagents (0x19d2, 0x5850, 8, 0x97ac), 14 Spells (0x19e2, 0x57f0, 0x30, 0x97b6), 15 Items (0x1916, 0xb9ee, 0x26, 0x97be), 16 Armaments (0x1962, 0x57c0, 0x30, 0x97c4) -> key = inventory_page(..). Non-list pages: select_text_window(2), key = read_command_key.
notes: vector 1778:06b6; the ecea and ed12 'functions' are fragments of this loop

name: fn_1000_ecea_fragment
purpose: Fragment of zstats_command: page = 0 (wrap after Armaments). FONT vector 1778:054e targets this address in FONT.OVL.

name: fn_1000_ed12_fragment
purpose: Fragment of zstats_command: dispatch for keys > 3 (4 next page, '0' page 12, '1'..'6' member page).

name: finish_stats_screen
purpose: draw_status_icon_bar, draw_status_top_bar, draw_status_separator, draw_status_window, then "Done\n" (0x97ce).

name: print_ready_refusal
purpose:
Prints "

" (0x97d4), msg, "

Item: " (0x97d8).

name: hands_state
purpose: Both hands (+0x1b, +0x1c) empty -> 2; left empty -> 0; right empty and class byte 0x1a7e[left item] != '0' (not two-handed) -> 1; else 0xff. The ee32 'function' is this function's return-0xff tail.

0x1a7e.name: g_item_class
0x1a7e.meaning: item class: 2 ring, 4 amulet, 0x20 one-handed, 0x30 two-handed, 0x40 armour, 0x80 helm

name: fn_1000_ee32_fragment
purpose: Fragment: the 'mov ax,0xff' tail of hands_state (edea) sharing its epilogue. COMSUBS vector 1778:094a targets this address in COMSUBS.OVL.

name: ready_item
purpose: Ready/unready item for member (Ghidra param_1=item, param_2=member); returns 1 only when a ring vanished (ends the browser). In combat the active combatant's monster-table slot pointer is kept. Items 0x1b/0x1d -> 0. Armour 9..0xf in combat with enemies left: refusal 0x97e2. Already equipped: remove_equipped_item(item, member), g_inventory[item]++ if < 99; in combat unreadying 0x2a restores the class tile 0x1ade[class index] into the slot's tile and anim tile; return 0. Ammunition: 0x1a/0x24 need g_inventory[0x1b], 0x1c needs g_inventory[0x1d] else refusal 0x981c. carried = sum of g_item_weight (0x1aae) over the six slots. Class 0x1a7e[item]: 2 ring (+0x1d free or 0x9916), 4 amulet (+0x1e or 0x98f0), 0x20 one-handed (hands_state 0xff -> 0x9892; 2 -> left hand; else free hand), 0x30 two-handed (hands_state != 2 -> 0x98ba; left hand), 0x40 armour (+0x1a or 0x9866), 0x80 helm (+0x19 or 0x9846), other classes write to record +0x1f (stale pointer). weight+carried <= strength (+0xc): slot = item, g_inventory[item]--; items 0x2a/0x2c vanish on rand(0..15)==0 (0x995e, ring slot 0xff, tone, return 1); readying 0x2a in combat sets the slot tile/anim tile to 0x1d. Else refusal 0x9942. Refusals via print_ready_refusal, return 0.

0x1ade.name: g_class_combat_tile
0x1ade.meaning: member combat tile per class (AMBFDTPRS order)

0x58a3.name: g_no_more_enemies
0x58a3.meaning: armour may be changed in combat once set

notes: TODO(verify) unknown item class target pointer

name: ready_browser
proto: int ready_browser(int first, int member, int mode)
purpose: Cursor list browser (Ghidra param_1=mode, param_2=member, param_3=first). mode 'R': g_inventory 0x57c0 (0x30), names 0x1962, marker 0x1ae8[item] when is_equipped else space; else Items page 0xb9ee (0x26), names 0x1916, marker space. Each pass: window 1, (1,1), entries from first via next_owned(member,..) until row 8, counting shown; the entry drawn at cursor_row (initially 1) gets 0xfd before and after and becomes the selection; status icon as inventory_page. Keys: Enter/space select (mode 'R': done = ready_item(sel, member); else done = 1); Esc: "Done\n" (0x9970) for 'R' else "None!\n" (0x9976), done, sel = -1; 1/3 up 1, 0xd5 up 7: at rows 1 and 4 scroll the list (if impossible and row 4, cursor up) else cursor up; 2/4 down 1, 0xd6 down 7: at rows 4, 7 or beyond the shown count scroll (if impossible, row 4 with more than 4 shown: cursor down) else cursor down; 0xd3 first entry, row 1; 0xd4 last page with the cursor on its last row. Returns the selected index when done.

0x1ae8.name: g_item_equipped_glyph
0x1ae8.meaning: glyph shown next to equipped items in the Ready list

name: ready_command
purpose: The Ready command: m = select_stats_member(0); if >= 0: first = next_owned(m, g_inventory, 0x30, -1); none -> "Thou art empty-\nhanded!\n" (0x997e); else "Item: " (0x9998), clear_status_separator, select_text_window(1), draw_status_title(name), draw_list_frame(8), ready_browser('R', m, first), then draw_status_icon_bar, draw_status_top_bar, draw_status_separator, draw_status_window.
